summary: Release 10.1 frontend check on the live web preview at 375x667 (no backend). 10 scenarios tested. 9 pass outright. 1 partly fails: on web, a real tap on the Sign pill of a not-yet-signed partner does nothing. The sign logic itself works when the click event is sent by script. A second bug: the result-card NEXT MATCH button is cut off as 'NEXT MAT…' at 375px. PASS: Home Coins|Fans|Trophies N/4 fits with no truncation, the Trophies cell opens /cabinet, back and share are present, the South shelf shows. DEV jump 5 shows Match 5 with the 'TWIST · HEAD START' chip and 'you lead 3–0' line, and coins stay at 300. PLAY MATCH on 5 opens /talk: the first speaker is MATZ, text types in ('Sorry' then the full line), taps advance through ANLI/MATZ/TINKU/MATZ/ANLI, and the last tap goes to /match. The sim starts at 3-0 (t=0). Match 8 starts 3-4, 10 starts 8-8, 12 starts 0-0. talk-skip goes to /match and saves talkSeen. Playing a seen but not-cleared match skips the talk. REPLAY of a cleared match (node-1) skips the talk. Twist pill 'QUICK FIRE — First to 7' shows on match 2 at t≈0.17 and is gone after 2s; the CLUTCH and LONG FINAL pills also show. Inbox: the welcome message is hidden after jumps, unread rows show opacity 1, they show 0.6 after reopening, and tapping overlay-backdrop or outside closes it. The overlay ScrollView scrolls (checked on the Stats overlay at 300px viewport height: scrollTop 0→104). Team: the 2-column grid fits (168px cards) with no truncation. Tapping Anli opens partner-popup. act-career gives the toast 'Anli is your Career partner' and act-train gives 'Anli is your Training partner' (trainingPartnerId saved). The sign dialog flow works (2300→1550 coins, Upsi signed and set as active, CAREER tag). team-info opens the Partner stats overlay with Growth and Chemistry rows. HUD: LOB tap turns the button gold (rgb 246,201,74) and sets sim.lobArmed=true; a second tap disarms it. NET/BACK toggles BACK→NET (kitchenMode retreat) and back. Cabinet after jump 4 shows 'MUMBAI · 1 OF 4' with Community Cup WON; the detail card shows only the title (old-save path, no details line), and Home shows Trophies 1/4. LEVEL UP pop-up (Anli reached Level 2, Lv1 › Lv2) and CHEMISTRY heart pop-up (♥ 25) show in order with dots after a forced game over. The DEV overlay shows 'court: loaded bandra_garden'. No page errors.

ui_bugs.issue: On web, a real pointer tap on the Sign/Need-more pill does nothing, so the sign dialog never opens. Cause: the card is a Pressable with disabled={!ps?.signed}, which react-native-web renders as <button disabled> with pointer-events:none. The StatusPill Pressable (another <button>) is nested inside it, and the browser drops clicks on children of a disabled button. Only a scripted dispatch_event('click') opens sign-dialog. React also logs '<button> cannot contain a nested <button>' / hydration error (shown as the red DEV error toast at the bottom of Team). Reference: /app/frontend/app/team.tsx:101-134

The primary button label shows as 'NEXT MAT…' at 375px (CAREER + NEXT MATCH + share row). adjustsFontSizeToFit is ignored on react-native-web, so numberOfLines={1} cuts the text off. This breaks the 'no … truncation at 375x667' requirement in the web preview. Reference: /app/frontend/src/ui/MatchEnd.tsx:236

issues: The status-trophies-cell tap target is 106x35, below the 44px minimum. Add minHeight 44 or a hitSlop.
Cards in the same row have different visible heights: the signed Anli card is shorter than the unsigned Upsi card next to it, because the inner Card does not stretch to the 154px cell.
The 'New players · Join in the South Cup' tile is see-through, so court lines show through it and contrast is low.

react_native_issues.issue: A StatusPill Pressable is nested inside a disabled roster Pressable. This breaks taps on web and causes a DOM-nesting/hydration warning. Reference: /app/frontend/app/team.tsx:101-134
It has no effect on react-native-web, so the label is cut off with an ellipsis. Reference: /app/frontend/src/ui/MatchEnd.tsx:236 (also used at app/career.tsx:69 nm-player-name)

action_items: team.tsx: for unsigned partners, render the roster cell as a plain View, not a disabled Pressable. Alternatively, drop the `disabled` prop and no-op onPress when not signed, and never nest a Pressable inside another. Then a real tap on status-<id> opens sign-dialog on web, and the nested <button> warning goes away.

MatchEnd.tsx: make sure 'NEXT MATCH' fits at 375px. Options: shrink primaryText fontSize or letterSpacing on narrow widths, drop the chevron when width < 380, or narrow the CAREER/share buttons. Do not rely on adjustsFontSizeToFit on web.
Optional: minHeight 44 on the Home status cells; equal-height cards in the Team grid; an opaque background on the New players tile.
critical_code_review_comments: match.tsx is 805 lines, over the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting the HUD/overlays out.
The DEV jump buttons are 36x36 (DEV only, OK).

success_rate.frontend: 90% (9/10 scenarios pass on web; sign via a real tap fails on web)

seed_data_creation: No seeding on the server. Each browser context used its own localStorage (pb.meta), changed with DEV jump/coins. For the LEVEL UP and heart pop-ups, pb.meta was edited in the browser: anli growth=95, chemistryHalves player+anli=48.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Viewport 375x667. On first load click 'Skip for now'. DEV: dev-jump-N and dev-coins on /career. Talk: dialogue-tap, dialogue-speaker, dialogue-text, talk-skip. To force a game over: window.__pwSim.score.nearScore=11; farScore=4; winner='near'; phase='game_over'. Celebration testIDs: celebration-kicker, celebration-title, celebration-heart, celebration-continue. Twist pill shows only while sim.time<2, so poll right after match-screen appears. On web, status-<id> must be clicked with dispatch_event('click') until the nested-Pressable bug is fixed. Twist start scores were checked: M5 3-0, M8 3-4, M10 8-8.
rca_of_issue: Sign pill not tappable on web: in team.tsx the outer roster Pressable is given disabled={!signed}. react-native-web renders it as <button disabled aria-disabled=true> with pointer-events:none, and the StatusPill <button> sits inside it. Chrome drops click events on children of a disabled <button>, so a real tap never reaches onStatus. Reproduce: dev-coins → dev-jump-4 → /team → tap status-upsi. Result: no sign-dialog, and the console shows the nested <button> warning. Fix: do not wrap unsigned cards in a disabled Pressable.
